Subject: Introduction + Partner Center referral payload (Contoso)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking this. We've just submitted a Partner Center referral for Contoso's cloud listing and wanted to share the account export so we can align on seller ownership. Please find attached an export (Contoso_ACCOUNTS_Q4_2025.csv) with the accounts in-scope for the co-sell push — ~48 accounts across NA.

Key asks from our side:
- Can Redwood propose a field-seller assignment for these accounts so we can confirm who will lead outreach?
- Any reason some of these accounts might be ineligible for Partner Center co-sell (e.g., already claimed, conflicts)?
- Can we get a short cadence (30–45min) to lock on owners and agree a mutual action plan?

Partner Center referral id: PC-REF-9182
Target timeline: Contoso wants initial outreach week of Nov 17.

Thanks,
Lara Nguyen
Sr. Partner Manager — ISV Ecosystems
Contoso Ltd.
Attachment: Contoso_ACCOUNTS_Q4_2025.csv (CSV, 48 rows)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Lara Nguyen <lara@contoso.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Introduction + Partner Center referral payload (Contoso)

Hi Lara — great to meet you and thanks for the export.

We can take point on mapping owners. Quick proposal below:

1) Approach:
- Run a quick account enrichment (internal and public signals) to attach a likely seller based on region, previous deal history, and seat velocity.
- Mark contested accounts (existing active Redwood contacts or enterprise deals) and route those for manual arbitration.

2) Deliverable:
- We will return a proposed mapping CSV (same format) with three columns: account, suggested_owner, rationale.
- We'll also flag eligibility issues (already-claimed in Partner Center, conflicting Marketplace listing, or legal/procurement constraints).

3) Timing:
- We can get a first-pass mapping back by Tue EOD (Nov 4) if we can confirm:
  a) Which Contoso BU/group is sponsoring outreach (Ops vs Cloud)?
  b) Any accounts you want excluded or prioritized?

4) Call: Nov 5 11:00–11:30 PT works for our GTM leads (Karthik and Jordan are looped). If that doesn't work, propose two alternatives and we'll adjust.

I've attached a proposed_mapping_template.csv that we will populate.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Field Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_proposed_mapping_template.csv (CSV, template)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Lara Nguyen <lara@contoso.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 08:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Introduction + Partner Center referral payload (Contoso)

Thanks — quick notes before the call:

- I reviewed the Contoso export; we have 9 accounts that are likely already touched by field sellers (past 18mo opps). I attached a snapshot of the seller roster we should consider when mapping (seller_roster_snapshot.pdf).

- For Azure Partner Center specifics: when we claim referrals we need a primary seller email + business justification. If an account is already claimed by Microsoft field or another partner, we flag it as contested and prefer a joint outreach plan.

- Suggested owner rules (to speed mapping):
  * If an account had an open Redwood deal in the last 12 months -> assign the previous AE.
  * If the account is labeled mid-market and in Western US -> assign Jordan (west quota).
  * Enterprise accounts (ARR > $250k) -> raise to Karthik for manual review.

- Caveat: Contoso's PC referral metadata includes "priority: high" on a subset. We should lock those owners first and propose a staggered outreach sequence to avoid overlap.

I'll QA the template and have the filled CSV back right after our call.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Field GTM, Redwood Inference
Attachment: seller_roster_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Solid alignment — thank you all. Quick summary + action items (consensus) from today's thread: 

Action items: 
- Karthik: finalize the owner mapping for enterprise accounts and return filled CSV by Wed Nov 5 EOD (file: redwood_proposed_mapping_template.csv).
- Jordan: take the west-region mid-market assignments and prepare intro email copy for co-sell outreach (Jordan will coordinate with our Marketing Ops for templates).
- Vanessa: consolidate contested account list and set up arbitration playbook for Partner Center claims (target doc by Nov 7).
- Lara/Contoso: confirm which Contoso BU is sponsoring (Ops vs Cloud) and highlight any accounts to exclude.

Notes/constraints:
- Partner Center referral id PC-REF-9182 noted; we will only claim once ownership is confirmed to avoid overwriting Contoso claims.
- Proposed outreach window: begin Nov 17 for prioritized subset (high priority first).

Next steps:
- Let's lock Nov 5 11:00 PT for a 30-min sync; invite below should land shortly. If that slot fails on your side, suggest two alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
